mapper.sql: id, user_id, loan_no_encrypted, bank_name, loan_type, loan_amount, balance, interest_rate, start_date, maturity_date, monthly_payment, next_payment_date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_loan WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_loan SET bank_name = #{bankName}, loan_type = #{loanType}, loan_amount = #{loanAmount}, balance = #{balance}, interest_rate = #{interestRate}, start_date = #{startDate}, maturity_date = #{maturityDate}, monthly_payment = #{monthlyPayment}, next_payment_date = #{nextPaymentDate} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND loan_no_encrypted = #{loanNoEncrypted}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_loan (user_id, loan_no_encrypted, bank_name, loan_type, loan_amount, balance, interest_rate, start_date, maturity_date, monthly_payment, next_payment_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{loanNoEncrypted}, #{bankName}, #{loanType}, #{loanAmount}, #{balance}, #{interestRate}, #{startDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{monthlyPayment}, #{nextPaymentDate})
